VULN-001.name: Hardcoded Password
VULN-001.description: A hardcoded password was found in the codebase
VULN-001.remediation: Use environment variables or secure configuration management

VULN-002.name: SQL Injection
VULN-002.description: Potential SQL injection vulnerability via string concatenation

VULN-003.name: Weak Cryptographic Algorithm
VULN-003.remediation: Use strong algorithms like AES-256, SHA-256

VULN-005.name: Command Injection
VULN-005.remediation: Use proper subprocess calls without shell=True

VULN-007.name: Insecure File Permissions
VULN-007.remediation: Restrict file permissions to minimum required

VULN-008.name: Exposed Secret
VULN-008.description: Potential API key or secret exposed
VULN-008.remediation: Rotate the secret and use secure configuration

DEP-001.name: aiohttp < 3.14.4 (2026 advisory wave)
DEP-001.description: aiohttp <= 3.14.3 affected by ~15 advisories in 2026: HTTP request smuggling via pure-Python parser (CVE-2026-111750), file descriptor exhaustion in multipart (CVE-2026-111066), missing initial request/header timeout (CVE-2026-111064), out-of-bounds heap read (CVE-2026-69244), WebSocket upgrade smuggling (CVE-2026-69243), connector pool exhaustion (CVE-2026-111065)

DEP-002.name: python-multipart < 0.0.31
DEP-002.description: python-multipart < 0.0.31 affected by arbitrary file write via non-default configuration (CVE-2026-24486, fix 0.0.22), DoS via unbounded multipart part headers (CVE-2026-42561, fix 0.0.27), quadratic-time querystring parsing (CVE-2026-53539, fix 0.0.30), negative Content-Length memory buffering (CVE-2026-53540, fix 0.0.31)

DEP-003.name: jinja2 < 3.1.6 (sandbox breakout)
DEP-003.description: jinja2 <= 3.1.5 affected by sandbox breakouts: via malicious filenames and indirect format reference (CVE-2024-56201, CVE-2024-56326, fix 3.1.5) and via attr filter selecting format method (CVE-2025-27516, fix 3.1.6)

DEP-004.name: requests < 2.33.0
DEP-004.description: requests < 2.33.0: .netrc credentials leak via malicious URLs (CVE-2024-47081, fix 2.32.4), insecure temp file reuse in extract_zipped_paths() (CVE-2026-25645, fix 2.33.0)

DEP-005.name: starlette < 1.3.1 (via old fastapi)
DEP-005.description: starlette < 1.3.1: form() limits silently ignored for urlencoded bodies (CVE-2026-54283, fix 1.3.1), O(n^2) DoS via Range header merging (CVE-2025-62727, fix 0.49.1), multipart DoS (CVE-2024-47874, fix 0.40.0), SSRF/NTLM theft via UNC StaticFiles on Windows (CVE-2026-48818, fix 1.1.0), Host header path poisoning (CVE-2026-48710, fix 1.0.1)
DEP-005.remediation: Upgrade starlette to >= 1.3.1 (requires fastapi upgrade; fastapi 0.109 pins starlette < 0.37)

DEP-006.name: fastapi <= 0.109.0 (Content-Type ReDoS)
DEP-006.description: fastapi <= 0.109.0 vulnerable to Content-Type header ReDoS (GHSA-qf9m-vfgh-m389, fix 0.109.1)
DEP-006.remediation: Upgrade fastapi to >= 0.109.1; for starlette 1.x support use fastapi >= 0.162.0

DEP-007.name: python-jose <= 3.5.0 (critical, no upstream fix)
DEP-007.description: python-jose: algorithm confusion with OpenSSH ECDSA keys (CVE-2024-33663, fix 3.4.0), DoS via compressed JWE (CVE-2024-33664), and DER-encoded public key bypass of the algorithm-confusion guard (CVE-2026-85394) affecting <= 3.5.0 with NO upstream fix
DEP-007.remediation: Migrate from python-jose to pyjwt or joserfc; pin allowed algorithms explicitly; never trust asymmetric keys as HMAC secrets

DEP-008.name: next.js 16.0.0 - 16.4.0 (October 2026 critical wave)
DEP-008.description: next 16.0.0-16.4.0: unauthenticated RCE in use-cache functions returning typed arrays (GHSA-673q-mjm6-r5xr, CVSS 9.5), unauthenticated RCE in Image Optimization API with SVG (GHSA-2464-fhr4-w9xw), DoS in App Router Server Actions (GHSA-p3m5-59mp-jv5r). All fixed in 16.4.1 (2026-10-22)
DEP-008.remediation: Upgrade next to >= 16.4.1 and rebuild/redeploy the container image

DEP-009.name: next.js 16.3.0 - 16.3.8 (cache leaks, SSRF)
DEP-009.description: next 16.3.0-16.3.8: cache leak across root param values in nested use-cache (CVE-2026-103004), cache poisoning of SSG/ISR in self-hosted apps (CVE-2026-94543, CVE-2026-94484), SSRF in Image Optimization (CVE-2026-94483), Draft Mode leak (CVE-2026-94544), metadata image route info disclosure (CVE-2026-94485). Fix 16.3.8 / 15.5.27
DEP-009.remediation: Upgrade next to >= 16.3.8 (or >= 16.4.1 to cover the October wave)

DEP-010.name: next.js < 16.3.3 (RCE wave September 2026)
DEP-010.description: next < 16.3.3 / 15.5.24: RCE in next/og ImageResponse (GHSA-vcvr-r3jv-pc5j), unauthenticated RCE in Image Optimization with AVIF (GHSA-2xp9-vwfh-vxw4), unauthenticated RCE on Windows-hosted servers (CVE-2026-75604)

DEP-011.name: drizzle-orm < 0.45.2 (SQL injection)
DEP-011.description: drizzle-orm < 0.45.2: SQL injection via improperly escaped SQL identifiers (CVE-2026-39356)
DEP-011.remediation: Upgrade drizzle-orm to >= 0.45.2; audit code for sql.raw() and dynamically built identifiers

DEP-012.name: zod < 4.6.6 (memory exhaustion)
DEP-012.description: zod < 4.6.6: memory exhaustion while validating oversized constrained collections (CVE-2026-54404)
DEP-012.remediation: Upgrade zod to >= 4.6.6; cap input sizes before schema validation

DEP-013.name: nanoid < 3.3.18 / < 5.1.16 (infinite loop)
DEP-013.description: nanoid: non-secure generators loop indefinitely with negative size (CVE-2026-67214, fix 3.3.16/5.1.16), custom generators loop when size is zero (CVE-2026-67213, fix 3.3.18/5.1.6)
DEP-013.remediation: Upgrade nanoid to >= 3.3.18 (v3 line) or >= 5.1.16 (v5+ line); validate size argument

WEB-001.name: nginx TLS session forgery (session tickets)
WEB-001.description: nginx 1.23.2-1.31.6: session forgery when using TLS session tickets (CVE-2026-97629). Fixed in 1.31.7 / 1.30.6; check distro backport status for packaged nginx
WEB-001.remediation: Upgrade nginx to >= 1.31.7/1.30.6 or verify distro backport (dpkg changelog); disable ssl_session_tickets if upgrade impossible

WEB-002.name: nginx HTTP/2 request injection in proxy
WEB-002.description: nginx 1.29.4-1.30.0: HTTP/2 request injection in ngx_http_proxy_module (CVE-2026-42926). Fixed in 1.31.0 / 1.30.1
WEB-002.remediation: Upgrade nginx to >= 1.31.0/1.30.1 or verify distro backport

WEB-003.name: nginx buffer overflow in map + regex
WEB-003.description: nginx 0.9.6-1.31.2: buffer overflow when using map with regular expressions (CVE-2026-42533, major). Fixed in 1.31.3 / 1.30.4
WEB-003.remediation: Upgrade nginx to >= 1.31.3/1.30.4 or verify distro backport

WEB-004.name: nginx HTTP/3 request body injection
WEB-004.description: nginx 1.25.0-1.31.6: request body injection in HTTP/3 (CVE-2026-95101). Fixed in 1.31.7 / 1.30.6
WEB-004.remediation: Upgrade nginx or verify distro backport; disable HTTP/3 listener if not needed

WEB-005.name: nginx OCSP result bypass in stream
WEB-005.description: nginx 1.27.2-1.29.6: OCSP result bypass in stream module (CVE-2026-28755). Fixed in 1.29.7 / 1.28.3
WEB-005.remediation: Upgrade nginx or verify distro backport; relevant when stream module terminates TLS with OCSP

WEB-006.name: nginx SSL upstream injection
WEB-006.description: nginx 1.3.0-1.29.4: SSL upstream injection (CVE-2026-1642). Fixed in 1.29.5 / 1.28.2
WEB-006.remediation: Upgrade nginx or verify distro backport

WEB-007.name: nginx memory disclosure via slice module
WEB-007.description: nginx 1.15.8-1.31.2: memory disclosure when using ngx_http_slice_module (CVE-2026-60005). Fixed in 1.31.3 / 1.30.4
WEB-007.remediation: Upgrade nginx or verify distro backport; disable slice module usage if not needed

WEB-008.name: nginx rewrite/SSI memory-safety issues
WEB-008.description: nginx: buffer overflow in ngx_http_rewrite_module (CVE-2026-9256 vuln 0.1.17-1.31.0 fix 1.31.1; CVE-2026-42945 vuln 0.6.27-1.30.0 fix 1.31.0), use-after-free in ngx_http_ssi_module (CVE-2026-56434 fix 1.31.3), buffer overflow with alias+rewrite (CVE-2026-15176 fix 1.31.7), script evaluation overflow (CVE-2026-93479 fix 1.31.7)
WEB-008.remediation: Upgrade nginx to >= 1.31.7 or verify distro backports; review rewrite/alias usage
